s.n: Night one spinach and artichoke dip
s.note: Warm spinach, artichoke and three cheeses with tortilla chips. Night one of the hall pass.
s.how: Baked dip of spinach, artichoke hearts, cream cheese, sour cream, mozzarella and parmesan, bubbling hot with tortilla chips. Heat the oven to 200C. Wilt 250g baby spinach in a dry pan, squeeze it dry and chop. Mix 250g softened cream cheese, 125g sour cream, 1 crushed garlic clove, 100g grated mozzarella and 40g grated parmesan. Stir in the spinach and 280g drained, chopped marinated artichoke hearts, season and spread in a baking dish. Top with 50g more mozzarella and bake 20 minutes until bubbling and golden. Serve hot with tortilla chips.

s.note: Sticky barbecue pork riblets with pickles, the order that puts Rick and Fred to sleep.
s.how: Pork riblets braised soft, then glazed with a smoky barbecue sauce and grilled sticky, with dill pickles on the side. Heat the oven to 160C. Rub 1.2kg pork riblets with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp brown sugar and salt. Wrap tightly in foil on a tray and bake 2 hours until tender. Unwrap, brush with 250ml barbecue sauce and grill or barbecue on high for 5 minutes a side until sticky and charred at the edges. Serve with dill pickles.

m.note: Chicken chow mein, soft noodles, cabbage and soy. Nothing fake about this chow.
m.how: Soft egg noodles stir-fried with chicken thigh, cabbage, carrot, bean sprouts and spring onion in a soy and sesame sauce. Slice 500g chicken thigh thinly and toss with 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp cornflour. Cook 400g fresh egg noodles for 1 minute, drain and toss with a little oil. Stir-fry the chicken in a very hot wok with 2 tbsp oil for 4 minutes and set aside. Stir-fry 3 cups shredded cabbage, 1 julienned carrot, 2 crushed garlic cloves and 1 tbsp grated ginger for 2 minutes. Add the noodles, chicken, 3 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp sugar and 2 tsp sesame oil and toss hot for 2 minutes. Finish with 2 handfuls of bean sprouts and sliced spring onion.

w.note: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies with nothing extra baked in. Learn from the golf course.
w.how: Dense, fudgy dark chocolate brownies with a crackly top, cut into squares. Heat the oven to 175C and line a 20cm square tin. Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g caster sugar, then 3 eggs one at a time and 1 tsp vanilla. Fold in 80g plain flour, 30g cocoa and a pinch of salt. Spread in the tin and bake 25 to 28 minutes until just set in the middle. Cool completely and cut into 16 squares.

d.note: Cold milk stirred with sweet coffee syrup, the Rhode Island way. Leigh's coffee shop does it best.
d.how: Rhode Island coffee milk: strong coffee simmered down to a sweet syrup, stirred into cold milk over ice. Simmer 250ml strong brewed coffee with 150g sugar for 10 minutes until syrupy, then cool. Stir 3 tbsp of the syrup into each glass of 250ml cold milk and serve over ice.
